segments.oily: An extremely oily reviewer found it more like a lotion that leaves skin soft, supple and brighter, and another with combination/oily skin said it worked without an oily finish.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report all-day hydration and relief from dryness, including one who calms persistent forehead dryness by pairing it with a toner, though one dry-skinned user needed a heavier product in winter and another switched to a richer cream after starting retinol.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers describe it as lightweight, non-greasy and good at balancing oily and dry areas, with several long-term repurchasers; one noted it felt drier than expected only after adding a prescribed retinol.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report hydration without irritation or greasiness, but one sensitive-combination user in the negative reviews experienced burning around the eyes and a scent she disliked.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal skin reported horrible deep breakouts and a neck rash after switching to this product from another moisturizer.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers in their late 40s to 60s report smoother, firmer-looking skin, reduced fine lines and compliments on their complexion, with one exception who saw no smoothing after nine months of daily use.

concerns.aging: Several mature reviewers report fewer visible fine lines, more firmness, and an 'ageless' look after weeks to months of use; one long-term user of nine months, however, saw no smoothing effect at all.
concerns.dehydration: The majority of reviewers, across skin types, report noticeably more hydration lasting through the day or overnight; a couple mention it does not perform as well around the nose or that hydration felt unremarkable compared to their usual routine.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive/oily-combination skin said the cream reacted well and calmed her skin, but this concern is mentioned by very few reviewers.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer described her skin as calmer and 'able to breathe' after switching to a Dermalogica routine including this cream.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reported reduced pore size and softer skin over time; another mentioned lingering dry patches and discoloration improving only after adding a full Dermalogica regimen, not the moisturizer alone.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers, including a parent using it on a teenage son and an adult managing her own acne, describe it as helpful for breakouts and irritation, but one reviewer with normal skin reported the opposite — deep breakouts and a rash after switching to this product.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers consistently report a non-greasy, matte-ish finish with no added shine or oiliness.
